_: preparing for regions (the list of 2026-11-20's seventeenth phase, idea 7; 943_climate15.py, C++ RD/RDList15p.cpp). gear: an armour set's warmth against the cold and coolness in the heat (the build-up's rate is 1 - gear - buff; cool below 0: hotter). heat: the hot regions, the hours the heat comes on, its seconds before it saps her. herbs: each region's herb in its resource points' piles. items: the herbs and the meals cooked from them (on every map; 'like' the item copied; buff [kind, amount, seconds]), recipes at the oven.

items.name: Frostleaf
items.looks: A pale mountain herb rimed with frost. Cooked with meat at an oven, it keeps the cold off.

items.name: Sandroot
items.looks: A gnarled desert root, dusty with sand. Cooked with berries at an oven, it keeps the heat off.

items.name: Frostleaf Stew
items.looks: A hot stew of meat and frostleaf: the cold comes on far more slowly for five minutes.

items.name: Sandroot Cooler
items.looks: Cool water steeped with sandroot and berries: the heat comes on far more slowly for five minutes.
